title: RoleQ: Role-Aligned Scales for Converting Language Models to Ternary
abstract: arXiv:2610.21808v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight quantization below four bits shrinks memory and bandwidth at a perplexity that looks acceptable, but often at the cost of factual knowledge and task accuracy. Ternary weights have mostly been obtained by training from scratch or long fine-tuning. We introduce RoleQ, a quantization framework that places scales by the functional roles of Transformer units rather than by the layout of the weight matrix, as conventional formats do. Vectors that read from the residual stream take one scale per output unit; those that write to it, one per input unit. The rule is structural, needs no search, calibration or stored state, and holds on integer and ternary grids. In a rotated basis it matches a per-layer axis search at half the solver work, and at ternary it cuts perplexity by up to half against layout-based placement in two families at every size from 0.6B to 14B, where per-row scales leave MMLU at chance. translated_title: RoleQ：面向语言模型三值化的角色对齐缩放方法
translated_abstract: 低于四比特的权重量化可以在看似可接受的困惑度下缩减内存与带宽，但往往以牺牲事实知识和任务准确率为代价。三值权重此前大多需要从头训练或长时间微调才能获得。我们提出RoleQ，一个量化框架，它按照Transformer单元的功能角色而非传统格式所采用的权重矩阵布局来放置缩放因子：从残差流读取的向量按每个输出单元使用一个缩放因子，向残差流写入的向量则按每个输入单元使用一个缩放因子。该规则是结构化的，无需搜索、校准或存储状态，并且在整数网格和三值网格上均成立。在旋转基下，它能以一半的求解器工作量达到与逐层轴搜索相当的效果；在三值量化下，相比基于布局的缩放放置方式，它在两个模型家族从0.6B到14B的所有规模上将困惑度最多降低一半，而基于行的缩放因子在这些规模上会使MMLU性能降至随机猜测水平。我们的轻量级训练后流水线（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: RoleQ提出按Transformer单元的功能角色（读取向量按输出单元、写入向量按输入单元）而非权重矩阵布局来放置量化缩放因子，无需搜索、校准或存储状态，在三值量化下将0.6B至14B两个模型家族的困惑度最多降低一半，并避免了基于行的缩放导致MMLU降至随机水平的问题。
en_tdlr: RoleQ places quantization scales by the functional roles of Transformer units rather than weight-matrix layout, requiring no search, calibration, or stored state, and at ternary precision cuts perplexity by up to half versus layout-based placement across two model families from 0.6B to 14B.
